about_short_description.short_description: Sorbet is a fintech platform designed to help freelancers, startups, and small businesses manage global payments and financial workflows.

product.name: Sorbet Wallet
product.description: A non-custodial digital wallet for freelancers to store stablecoins and manage payments securely and independently.

product.name: Global Invoicing
product.description: A tool for freelancers to create and send professional, customizable invoices supporting multi-currency payments including fiat and stablecoins.

product.name: Link-in-Bio
product.description: A customizable online profile for freelancers to showcase their portfolio, work, and client testimonials in one accessible link.

product.name: Analytics for Link-in-Bio
product.description: An analytics tool providing insights into traffic sources and performance metrics of the freelancer's Link-in-Bio profile.

product.name: Milestone-Based Escrow Payment System
product.description: A payment system that holds client funds in escrow and releases payments to freelancers upon completion of agreed project milestones.
